Virtual Tables in #PowerBI: Unlocking a New Dimension of Data ModelingWant to perform complex calculations without changing your core data model? "
""
"Virtual tables in Power BI are your secret weapon!These dynamic tables, created with DAX, exist only in memory.They allow you to:"
""
"* Perform on-the-fly calculations and aggregations."
"* Create custom summaries and groupings."
"* Simplify complex measures and relationships."
""
"Example:CALCULATE(    SUM('Internet Sales'[OrderQuantity]),    FILTER(        'Product',        'Product'[List Price] >= 1000    ))"
""
"This DAX expression calculates the total order quantity for products with a list price greater than or equal to $1,000. It uses the FILTER() function to create a virtual table containing only the products that meet the specified criteria."
